scope: Design-readiness review of authored sawmill/storage proposal before rendering

findings.issue: Drive/crew semantics remain too open to verify two lanes as functioning work cells.
findings.required_refinement: Retain a reachable hand crank and visibly linked feed drive in the buffered stage. Declare the parallel-stage drive/worker model explicitly; two independently staffed manual stations is a coherent no-new-fuel proposal. Queue/stop each blocked lane without destroying stock. No new recipe yield is inferred.

findings.issue: New physical receiving/reservation/dispatch spaces need unambiguous stock custody and relation to garage deposit.
findings.required_refinement: Keep one conserved stock ledger with inbound/unaccepted, owned/reserved and outbound states distinguished. Cancellation returns reservations; no stock is credited twice. The new warehouse docks do not replace garage-first truck deposit or resolve VC01. Show the continuous internal aisle and accessible pedestrian route in a roof-off/plan evidence view.

positive_findings: Buffered-feed stage buys less repetitive loading interruption; parallel stage creates distinct work-cell/labor opportunities.
Real input waiting racks, guarded cutting paths and downstream plank collection are visible mechanisms rather than ornament.
Storage starts from existing mixed typed storage competence and adds separated receiving/dispatch plus protected coordinated staging.
Expanded footprints/ports are allowed with explicit routing and scale constraints.
Costs, rates, capacities, unlocks, deployment caps and native behavior are not falsely declared approved.
next_action: Render the refined candidates and independently inspect actual evidence. Passing this design-readiness review would not pass art, animation, runtime, balance or owner selection.
